purpose: A drag-and-drop tree of rows, with a keyboard way as well, that reorders and re-nests: it writes nothing, it reports where a dragged row was dropped.
namedChanges: Comments made generic: the first two lines (which said the app's ONE drag and drop, that nothing else in `src` imports dnd-kit and that nothing uses HTML5 `draggable`) are reworded to "meant to be an app's ONE drag and drop: nothing beside it should use HTML5 `draggable`".
This unit's `tsconfig.json` leaves `noImplicitOverride` off (the source was built without it; `static activators` of the class `MousePointerSensor` does not compile with it on).

library.title: Sortable tree (drag and keyboard reorder)
library.note: Reports drops and writes nothing; needs @dnd-kit/core 6.3.1. The Description editor that uses it is description-parts-view.
